author: playtest_west
method: Read-only source review. No browser interaction or gameplay reproduction performed by this reviewer in this round.

hypotheses.title: Pausing immediately after handover may discard the next-order callback

sourceRefs.finding: completeDelivery clears the order and schedules a single callback after 2500ms. The callback only calls showOffer when there is no order and no HUD modal. It does not retry if the modal condition fails.
Pause opens the HUD modal. Resume clears pause/modal state and resets the clock delta, without requesting another offer.
The keyboard modal-dismissal path also clears pause/modal state without requesting another offer.
An empty order with no route target renders Waiting for an order / Orders appear here. This is an expected visible indicator for the proposed reproduction, not an observed failure.
Cancelling the area picker requests an offer if no order exists, suggesting a visible recovery path without relocating. That recovery is untested for this hypothesis.

reproductionPlan: Finish an accepted delivery using normal driving and the visible hold-to-hand-over interaction. Record the explicit reward/result before beginning this check.

Immediately after handover, before the 2500ms next-offer delay elapses, press P or click Pause. Record the timing and verify Paused is visible. If the next offer is already visible, the race window was missed and this attempt is inconclusive.
Keep the pause sheet open for at least 4 seconds of wall time, then click Resume.
Observe for at least 4 seconds after resuming without moving or opening another menu. Record the HUD, whether an offer appears, and a screenshot.
If the offer is missing, optionally test the bounded recovery path P > Change area > Stay here. Do not select a different area, reset progress, or create state with hidden controls.
Repeat after a later normal handover before describing the failure as reproducible. A normal handover followed by no pause provides the comparison case.
hypotheses.expected: After resuming, a new order should become available without an unrelated menu action.
hypotheses.predictedFailure: The paused modal suppresses the one-shot callback, leaving Waiting for an order / Orders appear here and no offer after Resume.
hypotheses.deduplication: Distinct from confirmed PT-009 map-focus escape, map Close behavior, and G10 cancellation of an already-present pending offer. Do not assign a confirmed PT issue based on this source review alone.
limitations: Root reported customer handover remained unfinished when this note was requested; the prerequisite was not reached in this review.
